Chapter VI Scoring System
✖️
Difficulty Multiplier
Easy ×1.0  ·  Medium ×1.5  ·  Hard ×2.0
🔥
Combo Multiplier
5 kills ×1.2  ·  10 kills ×1.5  ·  20+ kills ×2.0
⏱️
Wave Speed Bonus
Fast wave clear grants up to ×1.3 bonus.
📐
Final Formula
Base × Difficulty × Combo × Wave Bonus

🔒
Password Reset

Chapter VIII Tips & Tricks
⚔️Prioritise Archers first — they deal the most damage from a safe distance.
🃏Save Wildcards for Boss waves — they appear every 10 waves.
💀Hard mode doubles your score — essential for leaderboard competition.
🛡️Knights block frontal attacks — circle behind to deal full damage.
🔥Never break your combo — a 20-kill chain doubles your score output.
🖼️Upload your avatar first — it shows next to your name on the leaderboard.
